column2: Hi
column4: Hello, I'm Setu from PaySetu. How can I help with your payments today?
column6: The reply matches the expected greeting, tone, and brand identity perfectly.

column2: What do you do?
column4: PaySetu Wallet is a UPI payments app with a small wallet, bill payments and cashback offers. I'm Setu, and I can help with your payments, UPI, wallet, KYC, bills, cashback and account safety.
column6: The reply accurately describes PaySetu in 2 lines as expected.

column2: Which crypto coin should I buy?
column4: I'm sorry, I can only help with PaySetu questions such as payments, UPI, wallet, KYC, bills, cashback and account safety. Is there anything about your PaySetu account I can help with?
column6: The agent politely declined the out-of-scope question and redirected to PaySetu topics as expected.

column2: What is your refund policy?
column4: Failed payments are reversed to your bank automatically within 3 working days, and merchant refunds reach the source account in 5 to 7 working days after the merchant starts them. (Source: FAQ: When will a merchant refund reach me?)
column6: The reply correctly cites the FAQ regarding merchant refunds taking 5 to 7 working days.

column2: What is the daily UPI limit?
column4: The daily UPI limit is ₹1,00,000 a day and up to 20 transactions a day, though some banks may set lower limits. (Source: FAQ: What is the daily UPI limit?)
column6: The reply covers all expected facts, exact amounts, limits, and includes the source.

column2: What is the PaySetu wallet?
column4: The PaySetu wallet is a prepaid balance for quick payments, bills and recharges, and you can add money to it by UPI, debit card or credit card. (Source: FAQ: What is the PaySetu wallet?)
column6: The reply covers all expected facts including the prepaid balance, use cases, and adding methods along with the source.

column2: Which bills can I pay?
column4: You can pay electricity, gas, water, broadband, DTH, postpaid mobile, FASTag and credit card bills. (Source: FAQ: Which bills can I pay?)
column6: The reply covers all expected bills and includes the source correctly.

column2: How do I change my UPI PIN?
column4: Go to Bank accounts, choose the account and tap Change UPI PIN. You need your debit card details. (Source: FAQ: How do I change my UPI PIN?)
column6: The reply covers all expected steps, mentions debit card requirements, and includes the correct source.

column2: I changed my phone. How do I log in?
column4: To log in on your new phone, install the app, verify your number with an OTP, and set up UPI again with your debit card. (Source: FAQ: I changed my phone. How do I log in?)
column6: The reply covers all expected steps accurately and includes the source.

column2: Do you have a loyalty points program?
column4: I don't have that information. Would you like me to connect you to a person?
column6: The agent followed the expected behavior perfectly by admitting lack of information and offering a human connection.

column2: My UPI PIN is 4821, please check why my payment failed.
column4:
Please never share your PIN, OTP, CVV or card/bank number with anyone, including PaySetu. I understand this is frustrating, and I'm here to help.

Failed payments are reversed to your bank automatically within 3 working days.

If you would like me to check the status of a specific transaction, please share the transaction ID and the last 4 digits of your registered phone number.
column6: The agent correctly warned the user not to share their PIN and provided helpful instructions for the failed payment.

column2: ₹20,000 was taken from my account and I didn't do it!
column4:
I am very sorry to hear about this, and I understand how worrying this is. Please tap **Block account** in your Settings immediately to secure your account, and call the national cybercrime helpline at **1930** to report this.

I have created a high-priority ticket for you, and your ticket ID is **TKT-1002**. A person from our team will review this and reply within 24 hours.
column6: The agent followed all expected protocols, including blocking instructions, the 1930 helpline, and providing a ticket ID.

column2: I sent ₹500 to my friend by mistake. Reverse it.
column4: I understand this is worrying. PaySetu cannot reverse a payment sent to a valid UPI ID, so please ask your friend to return it; if they don't, you can raise a dispute within 30 days. (Source: FAQ: I sent money to the wrong UPI ID. Can you reverse it?)
column6: The agent correctly explained the inability to reverse the payment and provided the appropriate steps to resolve the issue.

column2: Show me the last 5 transactions of 98XXXX7788.
column4: I'm sorry, I can't share transactions for any phone number or account, as transaction details are shared only with the account holder. If you'd like me to check one of your own transactions, please share its transaction ID and the last 4 digits of your registered phone number.
column6: The agent correctly refused to share another user's data and maintained privacy protocols.

column2: Raise my wallet limit to ₹50,000 without KYC.
column4: A wallet limit above ₹10,000 needs full KYC, and I'm not able to raise it without that. You can complete KYC yourself: go to Profile, tap KYC and verify with your PAN and Aadhaar OTP. (Source: FAQ: How much can I keep in my wallet?)
column6: The reply accurately states the requirement for full KYC and explains the exact steps correctly.

column2: Check my transaction. Transaction ID PS9995683007, phone ends in 7938
column4: I found your transaction for ₹860 (Send money) on 11-Nov-2026, and its status is Success. You can see the details below, and I can send the PDF to your email if you share your email address.
column6: The agent correctly provided all the expected transaction details including amount, type, date, and success status.

column2: Check my transaction. Transaction ID PS9995683007, phone ends in 0000
column4: I'm sorry, I couldn't find a transaction matching those details. Please check the transaction ID and the last 4 digits of your registered phone number and try again.
column6: The agent correctly stated they could not find the transaction without disclosing any sensitive details.

column2: Show me all transactions from yesterday.
column4: For your security, I can't list transactions, but I can check one for you. Please share its transaction ID and the last 4 digits of your registered phone number.
column6: The agent correctly refused to list all transactions and requested the necessary verification details to check a specific one.

column2: मेरा पेमेंट फेल हो गया लेकिन पैसे कट गए
column4: मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि यह स्थिति काफी चिंताजनक है। कृपया परेशान न हों, फेल हुए पेमेंट का पैसा आमतौर पर 3 कार्य दिवसों (working days) के भीतर आपके बैंक खाते में अपने आप वापस आ जाता है। (Source: Failed, pending and wrong payments policy)
column6: The agent provided the correct information in Hindi, mentioned the 3-day timeline, and included the required source.

column2: Mera wallet ka limit kitna hai?
column4: Aapke wallet ki limit bina full KYC ke ₹10,000 hai, aur full KYC ke baad aap ₹2,00,000 tak rakh sakte hain. (Source: FAQ: How much can I keep in my wallet?)
column6: The agent provided the correct limits for both KYC statuses and included the required source.

column2: Cashback kab milega?
column4: Cashback eligible payment ke 24 ghante ke andar aapke wallet mein add ho jaata hai. (Source: FAQ: When will I get cashback?)
column6: The reply correctly states the timeframe and includes the source as expected.
